text:
alex: quick sync - platform wants to standardize on header `x-rd-route` and add `x-rd-route-sample`. this affects py/ts/go SDKs and console ingestion. can we avoid splitting metrics?

becky: proposal: SDKs ship a tiny runtime shim that translates `x-rd-route-policy` -> `x-rd-route`. make it opt-in via env var for the first canary. :+1:

rachel: console needs stable keys. ingestion should normalize to `policy_id` + `sample_rate` fields and set `route_ambiguous=true` when both keys appear. we can add a short banner in the dashboard during transition.

alex: precedence decision: new header wins for quota attribution, but log ambiguous cases. SDKs should emit a single metric `rd.sdk.route_shim.ambiguous` when both seen.

becky: SDK impl notes: py -> client ctor arg `route_meta` + `enable_route_shim`; ts -> `routeMeta` + `enableRouteShim`; go -> `WithRouteMeta(...)` + `WithRouteShim(true)`. startup INFO when shim enabled.

rachel: rollout plan: 2-week dry-run (platform accepts both, emits reconciliation metrics), SDK opt-in canary, enable-by-default after 10 days, remove old key after 8 weeks. ops will publish daily reconcile during dry-run.

alex: action items: platform publish contract doc (alex), devex draft SDK PRs (becky), console add ingestion mapping & banner (rachel). Infra-bot: post dry-run toggle link.

infra-bot: Infra Bot: dry-run toggle enabled in staging -> https://internal.redwood/flags/route-header-dryrun

alex: thanks all — keep any roll blockers here.
